jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: São Tomé and Príncipe has no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance. Its only binding rule relevant to AI is the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing in the 2016 Personal Data Protection Law (Lei n.º 3/2016), supervised by the national data protection agency (ANPDP), which has said it intends to work on AI instruments.
lead_institutions: Agência Nacional de Protecção de Dados Pessoais (ANPDP)
narrative.review_notes: This review was updated on 18 October 2026: the National Assembly, the national ICT institute (INIC), the government portal, the data protection agency, the telecoms regulator and the central bank were checked again; no online official gazette was found. Not yet verified from the official text: the documents listed on INIC's document page and those in the data protection agency's document library. The 2020 digital governance strategy, the 2025 cybersecurity strategy and the data protection agency's announced AI work remain pending.

instruments.official_title: Lei n.º 3/2016, de 10 de Maio – Lei de Protecção de Dados Pessoais
instruments.english_title: Law No. 3/2016 of 10 May – Personal Data Protection Law
instruments.issuing_authority: National Assembly (Assembleia Nacional) of São Tomé and Príncipe
instruments.current_status: Cited as 'Lei n.º 3/2016, de 10 de Maio – Lei de Protecção de Dados Pessoais' by the National Assembly in February 2017, when it adopted the law organising the data protection agency (ANPDP) that supervises it; no amendment or repeal was found. The available text is the National Assembly's final text approved in February 2016 (Diário da Assembleia Nacional, II Série, n.º 25, 12 February 2016); the promulgated Diário da República version and its entry-into-force date have not been found online.
instruments.summary: São Tomé and Príncipe's general data protection law, applying to the processing of personal data wholly or partly by automated means by public and private controllers. It requires consent or a listed necessity ground for processing, gives data subjects rights of information, access and objection, and in article 13 a right not to be subject to a decision with legal or similarly significant effects based solely on automated processing that evaluates personal aspects such as work performance, creditworthiness, reliability or conduct (with contract and statutory exceptions). It also restricts transfers of personal data abroad, requires notification or prior authorisation of processing by the national data protection authority and sets administrative and criminal sanctions.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The only binding national rule found that governs automated decision-making and profiling (art. 13), and the legal basis for the data protection agency that has said it intends to work on AI instruments.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: São Tomé and Príncipe's National Assembly site, the government portal, ministries and regulators were searched. No qualifying AI-governance document was found for strategy, government AI governance, ethics, risk and assurance, the public sector, procurement, cybersecurity, transparency, standards, sandboxes, readiness indices, sectoral rules, generative AI, drafts, international agreements or historical publications. The national ICT institute and the data protection agency's document library were unavailable and the official gazette is not online, so the promulgated text of the data protection law and its effective date are still to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Method note (original): This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The national ICT institute's website could not be accessed, no online official gazette was found, and the data protection agency's document library could not be read, so only one document could be read: the National Assembly's final approved text of the data protection law. São Tomé and Príncipe is marked for a later retry.

Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. inic.gov.st HTTP 500/proxy refused; parlamento.st reset/503 - Assembly site reached on its host www2.camara.leg.br/saotomeeprincipe (page titled 'Assembleia Nacional de S.Tomé e Príncipe'; hosting by the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies - flagged for review). Text read is the Assembly's final approved text (Diário da Assembleia Nacional II Série n.º 25, 12 Feb 2016); number/date from II Série n.º 37 (14 Feb 2017). Diário da República not online. anpdp.st is a JS SPA. Convention 108 act not found. Units covered: Law: National Assembly website (its own search: 'inteligência artificial', 'artificial', 'algoritmos', 'dados pessoais', 'cibercrime', 'Conselho da Europa'): no AI law or AI bill; the 2025 parliamentary ethics-code bill only mentions AI in passing. Data protection law Lei n.º 3/2016 recorded (art. 13 automated decisions). No online Diário da República search exists; searched, no other AI provisions found.; Government: gov.st portal (no document library, no AI documents); no national AI strategy, public-sector AI guideline or GenAI guidance found. 2020 digital governance strategy and 2025 cybersecurity strategy held as leads (no official text online).; Ministries: Searched, nothing found: no AI documents from education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries (most have no working website).; Regulators: ANPDP (anpdp.st is a JavaScript application; no AI guidance located), AGER telecom regulator (search: only a 2025 Internet Governance Forum news item listing AI as a panel topic), Central Bank BCSTP (search: nothing on AI). No cyber agency or standards body publications found.. Not reached: INIC (inic.gov.st returned HTTP 500 / CONNECT refused); parlamento.st (connection reset; Assembly site reached via its www2.camara.leg.br host instead); ANPDP document library (anpdp.st single-page app, no static document links); Diário da República of São Tomé and Príncipe (no official online portal found). Could not verify: Promulgated Diário da República text and effective date of Lei n.º 3/2016; Law organising ANPDP (Assembly bill texto final Feb 2017; enacted number not confirmed from an official source) - not recorded, not AI-specific; Convention 108: no evidence STP is a party; set null. strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

Local retry 2026-10-18 (home connection, Saudi Arabia, ~20-minute box): inic.gov.st now opens (HTTP 200, Next.js site, redirects to /en). Its /en/documents page lists 'Strategic Plan 2026-2030' (Jan 2026), 'Annual Report 2025' (Feb 2026) and 'Digital Transformation Guidelines' (Mar 2026), but all three links (/docs/plano-estrategico-2026-2030.pdf, /docs/relatorio-anual-2025.pdf, /docs/diretrizes-transformacao-digital.pdf) return HTTP 404 via curl and headless browser; contents unread, not recorded. No 2020 digital governance strategy on the INIC documents page. INIC news (85 items) shows a 16/07/2026 data-governance workshop item; no AI document. parlamento.st returns HTTP 200 via browser but is a parked 'Buy this domain' page (curl: TLS error 35 on some requests) - the Assembly's own domain is no longer controlled by the Assembly; www2.camara.leg.br/saotomeeprincipe still opens and the Lei 3/2016 PDF is HTTP 200. anpdp.st still a JS SPA (home 200, /legislacao fails with HTTP error in browser). gov.st citizen portal opens; no document library. ager.st opens; no AI documents on home page. bcstp.st opens; Plano Estratégico 2026-2030 PDF download timed out after ~17 MB (truncated, text not extracted) - unread. No new instruments; leads updated.
Wording note 2026-10-19 (narrative.review_notes): This review was updated on 18 October 2026: the National Assembly, the national ICT institute (INIC), the government portal, the data protection agency, the telecoms regulator and the central bank were searched again; INIC's document page now opens but its listed documents could not be downloaded, the data protection agency's document library is still unavailable and no online official gazette was found.
